school.school_name: あいち福祉医療専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a disclosure page where current-year syllabus PDFs are public while the latest target confirmation form is still the previous fiscal year.
search_queries: あいち福祉医療専門学校 2025 確認申請書 様式第2号
あいち福祉医療専門学校 2026 修学支援 確認申請書
steps: Start from the Aichi official-index artifact row for あいち福祉医療専門学校.
Confirm the 2026年度 section exposes syllabus and curriculum-map PDFs, but not a current-year target confirmation-form PDF.
Confirm the latest target confirmation-form link is under the 2025年度 section as 2025_kakuninshinsei.pdf.
Open 2025_kakuninshinsei.pdf and verify that its body contains あいち福祉医療専門学校 and 様式第２号.
Classify the case as publication lag for target FY2026 because current-year syllabus PDFs must not be counted as target confirmation forms.

reusable_rules: Do not accept 2026年度 syllabus or curriculum-map PDF links as target confirmation forms.
Keep the latest previous-year 確認申請書 / 様式第２号 PDF as operator-reviewable publication-lag evidence when no current-year target-form link exists.
Use section headings such as 2025年度 as local fiscal-year context for the following target-form links.
anti_patterns: Do not infer target-form status from 2026 in a syllabus filename or anchor.
Do not let current-year syllabus PDFs hide a previous-year target confirmation form on the same disclosure page.
Do not count a previous-year target-form PDF as strict FY2026 success without local R8/FY2026 target-form evidence.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found an official-index-linked public-documents page where the 2026年度 section contains syllabus/curriculum PDFs, while the latest target confirmation-form PDF is 2025_kakuninshinsei.pdf under the 2025年度 section. Source-side PDF text extraction verified あいち福祉医療専門学校 and 様式第２号; the PDF body does not contain 令和8年度, so this case must remain publication_lag_latest_public for FY2026.
